query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628),'options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0624-0628:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id=d.entity_id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628)) OR (d.entity_type='note' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id=d.entity_id AND n.source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628)) OR (d.entity_type='mcq' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE m.id=d.entity_id AND m.source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628))),'bad_mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT m.id FROM public.gk_mcqs m LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcq_options o ON o.mcq_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628 GROUP BY m.id HAVING count(o.id)<>4 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_correct)<>1) q),'invalid_verification_statuses',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628 AND verification_status NOT IN ('verified','source_attributed','conflicting','unverified','rejected')),'orphan_batch_assignments',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a WHERE a.assigned_by='batch-0624-0628-quality-pipeline' AND ((a.entity_type='fact' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id=a.entity_id)) OR (a.entity_type='note' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id=a.entity_id)) OR (a.entity_type='mcq' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE m.id=a.entity_id)))),'invalid_batch_tag_categories',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN public.content_tags t ON t.id=a.tag_id WHERE a.assigned_by='batch-0624-0628-quality-pipeline' AND t.category NOT IN ('domain','content_type','theme','exam_source','quality')),'mcq_breakdown',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x) ORDER BY x.source_page,x.source_question_number),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.source_page,m.source_question_number,count(o.id) AS option_count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_correct) AS correct_count FROM public.gk_mcqs m LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcq_options o ON o.mcq_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 624 AND 628 GROUP BY m.id,m.source_page,m.source_question_number) x)) AS integrity LIMIT 1;
